data.gender_notes: Eshani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eshani is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. In Hindu mythology, Eshani represents the goddess of love and fertility. She is often depicted as a beautiful woman with multiple arms, holding lotus flowers and a trident. Eshani is also considered the wife of Lord Shiva and the mother of Kartikeya, the god of war. The name Eshani carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Fertility” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eshani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and fertility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eshani belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love and Fertility.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eshani total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
